items.title: Live Updates: France Deploys Vast Security Force in Bid to Prevent More Riots
items.summary: As many as 70,000 police and security officers will try to avert the arson and looting that shocked the country last weekend. The interior minister estimated that 35,000 people were out on streets nationwide by midday.

items.title: Israel Launches Crackdown in West Bank City After Deadly Attack
items.summary: The military demolished buildings and erected roadblocks in Hebron, the biggest city in the territory, a day after Palestinian gunmen killed two soldiers.

items.title: ‘Eagle’s Nest,’ Nazi-Era Guesthouse in German Alps, Is Gutted by Fire

items.title: Speed of Starshield Satellite Network Is Improving, Ukraine Says
items.summary: The announcement followed more than a week of disruption to Starshield, the Pentagon-funded satellite network that Ukraine relies on to thwart Russian attacks.

items.title: Looting Left Damage and Fear on Paradise Street in Marseille
items.summary: Looters ravaged a storied commercial avenue in France’s second-largest city. Its merchants fear that more unrest could follow.
